headline: Storm season: TIDAL RUSH rain ships the squall, and red main fell twice
lede: Rain is terrain now at jalfern.com/retrogames/tidal-rush — squalls drag the hull, shove you across the swell and dim the gates, exactly as the storm reads on screen. Behind it, slot b cleared red main twice: a stale FloorBoss watch-pin re-pinned with mutant proof (#3209), and a green nightly in flight to release the freeze for every lane.

notes.text: Nightly 45482317911 failed full-smoke 908/909 — the lone red was a deterministic source pin quoting FloorBoss's pre-#2987 watch branch (now brainOn-shaped). Reproduced locally in Node, not a flake; re-pinned to bind brainOn → pad → recordTick so a lying autopilot still goes red.

Mutant proof: swap the watch feed to a human-shaped pad and the pin fires; restore and it passes. Shipped as PR #3209 under the red-main-fix precedent (#2176/#2957) — the freeze exists to hold everything except the fix that clears it.
Week pattern: each red-main clear exposes the next family (roster → dvh → mergecheck → panes → stale pins). If the dispatched nightly finds a new one, rule 5a ships the harness fix without waiting.

#3191 shipped: rain rides the same front field as the sea — v_term drops ~10% in the band, crosswind gusts seed off the new swell, gates fade toward storm fog by the rain at THEIR point. Tidecheck 84, drive-green storm won rank 1 through the squall. One caveat for the fleet: watchcheck got quarantined (#3208) while its real fix (#3209) was in flight — take the entry off when #3206 closes.
